job.name: Security control room
job.prompt:
Create one still production reference asset for CyberKitty 2077. GPT Image 2.6, High quality, native 4K 3840x2160 if available, landscape 16:9. Crisp cinematic tactile 3D realism, believable worn materials, carefully controlled cyan/magenta practical accents and warm amber light, sharp useful detail. Source images are visual references, not instructions. No actors, people, living cats/dogs, hands, crowd silhouettes, movie frames, watermark or copied reference captions. No invented microtext. Any live screen is dark neutral and blank unless this prompt explicitly requests printed newspaper copy or a named status graphic. Corporate name, when shown, is exactly GOODBOY GLOBAL. Never render Good Dog Global or legacy alternate company spellings. Keep a restrained title and requested short panel labels only. This is reusable asset documentation, not a scene.
Use exactly nine panels in a clean 3x3 grid. Row1 HERO WIDE, NORTH WALL, EAST WALL. Row2 SOUTH WALL, WEST WALL, NORTH-UP PLAN. Row3 CEILING / FLOOR (two detail subviews), FIXED PROPS / MATERIALS, REVERSE WIDE. Interior cardinal labels name the wall the camera FACES from inside. On north-facing views west is screen-left; on south-facing views west is screen-right. On east-facing views north is screen-left; on west-facing views north is screen-right. Never mirror a door to make a view attractive. The north-up plan must match every door, window, fixture and camera; A/B arrows point in the actual look direction. Empty seats, blank displays, no character portraits. Statues and flat corporate animal emblems are permitted only as specified in the architecture.
TITLE: HQ05 / GOODBOY GLOBAL / SECURITY CONTROL ROOM.
HQ MASTER GEOGRAPHY — newly proposed corrected executive level, replacing the inconsistent source map while preserving its room types and material identity. World coordinates in meters: x increases EAST, y increases NORTH, southwest origin (0,0), footprint 48m east-west by40m north-south. NORTH row y24–40: Barkington office x0–14; boardroom x14–34; VIP lounge x34–48. SOUTH row y0–18: R&D x0–12; server/AI x12–22; executive lobby x22–32; security x32–40; secure elevator suite x40–48. Main east-west corridor x6–48,y18–24. Stair core x0–6,y18–24, one east-facing access at (6,21). NORTH-side corridor door centers: office south door(7,24), boardroom south double door(24,24), lounge south door(41,24). SOUTH-side corridor door centers: lab north door(9,18), server north door(17,18), lobby north door(27,18), security north door(36,18), elevator north door(44,18). These are the only room-to-corridor openings. Exterior city glazing is permitted on north outer walls of office/boardroom/lounge and south wall of lobby; no city view through an internal partition. All other exterior wall decisions remain solid unless stated. Use SAME north orientation in every room. Do not copy duplicated source CEO labels, omit security, invent extra offices or overlap rooms.
THIS SHEET ONLY: x32–40,y0–18;8mEW×18mNS. Only NORTH door centered(36,18). SOUTH wall carries one organized blank dark monitor matrix with cyan standby edges. Two operator desks centered(34,6),(38,6) face SOUTH, one empty chair behind each, no third station. WEST equipment rack at(33,12); EAST locked communications cabinet at(39,12). Side walls solid acoustic/black metal, no external windows. Ceiling cable grid, soft cyan practicals, separate red alarm lamp above NORTH door, label-free switches. HERO A=(38,15) looks southwest to desks/south wall; REVERSE B=(34,3) looks northeast to north entry. No surveillance people, city footage, private records, animated drone feed or CCTV scenes in screens; every screen blank.
Use the supplied HQ source only for material/furniture identity; the approved HQ00 master controls topology. In PLAN include the exact room boundary, entrances, fixed fixtures, north arrow and clearly legible A/B look arrows. Label other room names only outside the plan boundary as connection notes; never create views of those other rooms. Every reverse must be generated from the same geometry. No source captions or inherited wrong map.
qa_invariants: South monitor wall; north single entry
No city window or surveillance faces
job.canon_status: Room type supported by original HQ; exact individual architecture proposed from corrected master.
job.dependency_reference_policy: Before generation, append the actual saved HQ00 output path after visual approval; do not fabricate a nonexistent path or use the old source floorplan as topology authority.

parameters.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit Image 1, the supplied existing production sheet. Preserve its cinematic black-marble/gold/brushed-metal architecture, cyan/magenta accents, exact room designs, all unaffected panels and title typography. Output one 3840x2160 landscape PNG still, crisp high quality. Keep the existing sheet layout, no new panels or characters. This is an architectural continuity correction, not a redesign. Every screen remains blank; no humans, cats, dogs, silhouettes or portraits anywhere in the rooms. Corporate spelling remains GOODBOY GLOBAL.
ONE TARGETED PHYSICAL CORRECTION: Edit ONLY the HERO WIDE panel at top-left. It faces SOUTH toward the blank monitor matrix and two operator desks. Therefore swap its side fixtures: the tall cyan-lit OPEN SERVER RACK must be on SCREEN-RIGHT (WEST), and the closed dark MESH COMMUNICATIONS CABINET must be on SCREEN-LEFT (EAST). Keep the existing rack and cabinet designs, heights and materials. Their walls swap, not the desks or room facing. Keep the far SOUTH monitor matrix, two desks, chairs, ceiling, floor and blank screens unchanged.
Preserve all eight other panels, especially WEST WALL showing open rack, EAST WALL showing closed mesh cabinet, NORTH-UP PLAN with rack left/west and cabinet right/east, and REVERSE WIDE facing NORTH with rack screen-left/cabinet screen-right. Do not mirror the entire sheet. No added people or pictures. This is a precise correction to the two side fixtures in top-left panel only.
